description: Find tables by name or description text across libraries. Matches TABLE_NAME, SYSTEM_TABLE_NAME, and TABLE_TEXT. Use * as a wildcard. When a schema allowlist is configured, only those libraries are searched. Otherwise system libraries (Q* and SYS*) are skipped unless include_system is true.

filter.description: Name or text to match. Use * as a wildcard. Example: "ORDER*" matches tables starting with ORDER

include_system.description: Include Q* and SYS* libraries. Ignored when a schema or a schema allowlist is set.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Capped by QUERY_MAX_LIMIT.

schema.description: Limit the search to one library. Must be in the schema allowlist when one is configured.

name: search_tables
title: Search Tables
